pages.title: String Coupling Crystal
pages.text: Turn this crystal and the strength with which strings interact changes. Turn it far enough and a strongly coupled string theory becomes a weakly coupled one of a different type: this is string duality. It is cool and smooth and feels slightly alive.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fixed a compactified circle's radius with a bulk crystal and varied the coupling in the Compactification Lathe. At strong coupling, Type IIA became M-theory, and the crystal captured the transition.
